name: Italy
hook: Rome, the Renaissance and Il Duce: the boot-shaped country comes with a ready-made cast.

facts.label: Rome
facts.statement: Rome became Italy's capital only in 1870, the last territory absorbed in unification; Florence had held the title before it.

facts.label: Benito Mussolini
facts.statement: Benito Mussolini, called Il Duce, ruled Italy as a Fascist dictator and allied with Hitler in World War II.

facts.label: the Renaissance
facts.statement: Florence is the birthplace of the Renaissance, and Leonardo da Vinci painted The Last Supper in Milan.

facts.label: the Po
facts.statement: The Po, Italy's longest river, crosses northern Italy from the French frontier to the Adriatic, where its delta advances 200 feet a year.

facts.label: Sicily
facts.statement: Sicily is Italy's largest island and an autonomous region; the Strait of Messina separates it from the mainland.

facts.label: San Marino
facts.statement: San Marino, founded by tradition in 301, is a tiny republic on the Italian peninsula and a short bus ride from Rimini.

facts.label: Galileo Galilei
facts.statement: Galileo Galilei, the Pisan astronomer, has Pisa's airport and a Jupiter probe named for him.
